definition: to distribute money, time or resources for a particular purpose
example: The board decided to allocate more funds to research.

definition: to become responsible for a cost or penalty as a result of your own actions
example: Late payment will incur an additional fee.

definition: to pay back money that someone has spent or lost
example: The company will reimburse all travel expenses within two weeks.

definition: to state clearly that something is required, usually in an agreement
example: The contract stipulates that delivery must take place within thirty days.

definition: to make something less severe, harmful or painful
example: New safety measures should mitigate the risk of accidents.

definition: to make a system or process simpler and more efficient
example: We streamlined the approval process to save time.

definition: to examine something very carefully and in detail
example: Auditors scrutinize every transaction before signing off the accounts.

definition: to delay something until a later time
example: The committee deferred its decision until next quarter.

definition: to act in accordance with a rule, order or request (comply with)
example: All suppliers must comply with the new safety regulations.

definition: to make a process happen more quickly
example: We can expedite the shipment for an extra charge.

definition: legal responsibility for something; also a debt owed by a company
example: The firm accepted no liability for the damage.

definition: the total sales of a business in a period; also the rate at which employees leave
example: Annual turnover rose by twelve percent.

definition: something that encourages a person to act in a particular way
example: Bonuses are an incentive for staff to meet their targets.

definition: an amount left over when more than needed has been produced or earned
example: The department reported a surplus of two million dollars.

definition: the amount by which something is less than what is needed
example: A shortfall in revenue forced the company to cut its budget.

definition: the land and buildings used by a business
example: Smoking is not permitted on the premises.

definition: a document listing goods or services supplied and the amount to be paid
example: Please settle the invoice within thirty days.

definition: a written promise by a company to repair or replace a faulty product
example: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.

definition: a detailed plan of a journey, with places and times
example: Our itinerary includes stops in Lyon and Geneva.

definition: work that has not been done yet and keeps accumulating
example: Staff worked overtime to clear the backlog of orders.

definition: a person or group with an interest in the success of a business
example: All stakeholders were consulted before the merger.

definition: a standard used to compare the quality or performance of something
example: The report sets a benchmark for customer service.

definition: the income a company receives from its activities
example: Online sales generated most of our revenue last year.

definition: the act of following a rule, law or standard
example: The audit checks compliance with environmental law.

definition: having the skill and experience to do something well
example: Candidates should be proficient in spreadsheet software.

definition: possible to do and practical
example: The engineers believe the plan is feasible within the budget.

definition: able to work or succeed, especially financially
example: The project is no longer financially viable.

definition: waiting to be decided or settled
example: The merger is pending regulatory approval.

definition: required by a law or a rule
example: Attendance at the safety briefing is mandatory.

definition: not certain or final; subject to change
example: We made a tentative reservation for Friday.

definition: large in amount, value or importance
example: The firm made a substantial profit despite the slowdown.

definition: no longer needed; of a worker, dismissed because the job no longer exists
example: Fifty employees were made redundant after the restructuring.

definition: unwilling and hesitant to do something
example: Investors were reluctant to commit more capital.

definition: producing a lot of money
example: She turned down a lucrative job offer to start her own firm.

definition: very careful and precise about details
example: The accountant is meticulous about keeping records.

definition: about to happen very soon
example: A decision on the takeover is imminent.

definition: before a particular time or event
example: Please submit the form prior to the deadline.

definition: despite; in spite of
example: Notwithstanding the delay, the project was completed on budget.

definition: in accordance with a rule, law or contract
example: Pursuant to clause four, the deposit is refundable.

definition: used to compare two facts that are in contrast
example: Sales rose in Asia, whereas they fell in Europe.

definition: only if; on the condition that
example: We will proceed provided that the funding is secured.

definition: in spite of what has just been said
example: Costs rose; nevertheless, we kept our prices stable.

definition: as a result of something
example: The main supplier failed; consequently, production stopped.

definition: completely and with great attention to detail
example: Inspect the equipment thoroughly before each use.

definition: to watch and direct the work of others
example: She oversees a team of twelve engineers.

definition: to give part of your work or authority to someone else
example: Good managers delegate routine tasks to their teams.

definition: a statement about what is expected to happen, based on available information
example: The forecast predicts slower growth next year.

definition: not required to follow a rule or pay a charge
example: Non-profit organizations are exempt from the tax.

definition: of a payment or task, not yet paid or completed
example: Please settle the outstanding balance by Friday.

definition: to expand into new products, markets or activities
example: The company diversified into renewable energy.
